title: Fence breach
goal: Put a fence with a ceiling round the field, fly a waypoint above it, and see the fence bring the vehicle back.

steps.text: Plan a fence round the field with a 40 m ceiling, and a waypoint in the field at 60 m. Upload the plan.
steps.hint: Fence › Area: click each corner, then the first again; set the ceiling under Fence settings. The plan warns that the waypoint is above the ceiling: that is the point.

steps.text: Switch to Auto. It climbs towards the waypoint, through the ceiling.
steps.hint: Auto flies the plan from its first item. Go to refuses a place outside a fence; a mission does not.

steps.text: Let the fence's action bring it back under the ceiling, inside the field.
steps.hint: The breach action takes over: Return to launch unless you chose another.

fails.says: Failed. It landed outside the field.

passed: Passed. The fence brought it back in {elapsed}.
